propositions: Deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be swept from live prose and replaced with 'Acceptance Criteria' terminology in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl

A count-pinned allowlist file scripts/criteria-vocabulary-allowlist.txt must enumerate non-vacuous exemptions for four permanent semantic carve-outs and all frozen fixtures, with exact counts that fail on both increase and decrease

A deterministic scanner scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py must detect case-insensitive full-phrase and scoped bare-token reintroduction across the repository, excluding archive, experiments, vendor bundles, and cache directories, and must be wired into the root Makefile lint target

Bare tokens 'SC' or 'SCs' are scoped only to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md; injection outside these paths must not fail
The allowlist must reject malformed entries, duplicate paths, absent paths, and count drift in either direction; all four O-RAN-SC sites and captured Jira fixtures must remain byte-identical
After migration and guard implementation, a full-repository sweep must find no live deprecated vocabulary outside the allowlist, and make lint, make typecheck, and pytest suite must pass
